description: Red Matriz Sistema Acueducto. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Red encargada de mantener las presiones básicas de servicio para garantizar el correcto funcionamiento de todo el sistema, sin que existan derivaciones para consumo sobre ella. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Its tags are Acueducto y alcantarillado, Bogotá D.C., EAAB, Matríz, Presión. It offers 1 resource(s) in ESRI REST. The portal shows 2022-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
